decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding John Sowers' league affiliation. Document 1 (D1) consistently states he played in the 'NCAA Division I men's basketball league' during the 1962-1963 season. Document 2 (D2) claims he made an 'unprecedented jump to the National Hockey League' (NHL). Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat all audits as fallible without inventing authority to resolve the contradiction, both leagues are returned as valid answers based on their respective source texts.
